fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Normal compaction (`compact_txn._compact_locked`, `compact_txn.py:522-654`), the fsck rebuild
(`compact_rebuild.rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log`, `compact_rebuild.py:107-238`) and crash
recovery (`compact_recovery.py:128-202`) each re-derive the same decisions in their own code:

* **candidate listing** — `compact_txn._parse_candidate_events` (196-223) vs
  `compact_rebuild._partition_rebuild_sources` (59-84) vs `compact._foldable_event_count`
  (`compact.py:176-225`): three hand-rolled `listdir` + dotfile/`-SYNC.json` filters + JSON
  parses.
* **the "is this a SNAPSHOT file" test** — `compact_txn._is_snapshot_path` (226-228),
  re-inlined at `compact_txn.py:633-637` (the source-uuid filter added by bug
  `privileged-nephelite-colt` / `aea0`), and spelled a third way at `compact_rebuild.py:75-79`.
* **the SNAPSHOT envelope** — `compact_txn._build_snapshot_event` (297-326) vs the inline copy
  at `compact_rebuild.py:164-195`; the former's docstring already admits it is "mirroring" the
  latter. `"source_event_uuids":` and `"compacted_at":` appear as dict keys in exactly these
  two places.
* **the `*.retired` rename-back rule** — `compact_txn._retire_folded_sources` (329-397),
  `compact_txn._rollback_fold` (418-454) and `compact_recovery._revert_partial_fold` (128-164)
  each restore sources, then remove the uncommitted SNAPSHOT *only* when every reverse-rename
  succeeded (the data-loss guard from bug `compulsory-pernickety-mantis` / `e72e`), and two of
  them also `git reset` the ticket dir. `os.rename(retired, ...)` appears three times.
* **the commit step** — `compact_txn._commit_compaction` (401-415) vs
  `compact_rebuild._commit_rebuild` (88-103): the same `add -A <id>/` → `diff --cached --quiet`
  → `commit --no-verify -m` skeleton, differing only in message and error handling.
* **the two-arm "needs folding" rule** — `compact._scan_snapshot_state` (228-283) vs
  `compact_trigger.ticket_needs_folding` (88-117), including the `any(n.endswith(
  "-SNAPSHOT.json") ...)` probe in both.

Open story `plush-excessive-willet` (snapshot as derived cache) is a later design change this
planner makes cheaper; it does not overlap.

## Approach
Add `src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py` — no I/O policy of its own, only the shared
derivations — and route the three paths through it:

* `Candidate` (frozen dataclass: `path`, `name`, `uuid`, `timestamp`, `event_type`, with
  `is_snapshot` / `is_active` / `is_known_type`) and
  `list_candidates(ticket_dir, *, include_retired=False)`.
* `is_snapshot_event_file(name)` and `source_uuids_of(candidates)` — the `aea0` exclusion rule
  in one place.
* `has_snapshot(ticket_dir, *, default)` and `needs_folding(foldable, has_snap, threshold)`.
* `build_snapshot_event(tracker, ticket_dir, compiled_state, source_uuids, snapshot_ts)`
  returning `(event, final_path)`; `git_author()` moves here with it.
* `restore_retired(originals) -> bool`, `discard_uncommitted_snapshot(path)`,
  `unstage_ticket_dir(tracker, ticket_id)` — the rename-back rule and its data-loss guard.
* `commit_ticket_dir(tracker, ticket_id, message) -> tuple[bool, str]`; each caller keeps its
  own reaction (`compact_txn` writes the stderr line and returns 1; `compact_rebuild` ignores).

**Deliberately NOT consolidated.** `compact_rebuild`'s forward retire loop
(`compact_rebuild.py:198-205`) keeps its per-file tolerance and its `.snapshot-rebuild.bak`
idempotent-restart crash model. Giving it the fold's abort-and-roll-back semantics would change
observable behaviour on a repair path (today a rename failure is logged and the rebuild still
succeeds), and bug `e72e` scoped its journal/rollback design to the fold, not to the rebuild.
The intent journal, `.bak` sentinel and in-process abort seams are unchanged; fsck remains the
sole owner of mixed state (`compact_recovery.py:22-26`).

**Recorded convergence.** `_partition_rebuild_sources` filters only dotfiles and `-SYNC.json`,
so a stray non-event file in a ticket dir (no `.json` suffix) was cited in
`source_event_uuids` and renamed to `*.retired`. `list_candidates` requires the `.json` (or
`.json.retired`) suffix that the other two scans already required. This is the one behaviour
that converges; it is covered by a new test and is not pinned by any existing test.

## Guard construction
`compact_plan._offending_line(line)` (mirroring `rebar._store.paths._offending_line`) flags a
line outside the owner that either writes a SNAPSHOT-envelope key (`source_event_uuids` or
`compacted_at` in dict-KEY position — the call-target/argument-position shape the epic rule
sanctions) or performs the retired rename-back (`os.rename(` with `retired` in first-argument
position). A `# compact-plan-ok: <reason>` marker excuses a line; a bare marker is itself an
offence. `tests/unit/commands/test_compact_plan.py` scans every `src/rebar/**/*.py` except the
owner, and unit-tests `_offending_line` in both directions.

## Scope
`src/rebar/_commands/compact_plan.py` (new), `compact_txn.py`, `compact_rebuild.py`,
`compact_recovery.py`, `compact.py`, `compact_trigger.py`,
`tests/unit/commands/test_compact_plan.py` (new). `_compact_locked` and `compact_all_cli` sit
at their C901 ceilings, so edits there are subtractive only.

## Testing
Happy path: a normal fold and a rebuild over the same ticket directory produce SNAPSHOT events
whose `source_event_uuids` agree, and both envelopes carry the same key set. Edge: a stray
non-`.json` file is neither cited nor retired by the rebuild. Guard: the tree scan plus the
four `_offending_line` direction tests. Pinning (must pass with no assertion edits):
`tests/unit/test_compact_crash_atomicity.py`,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_process_death.py` (real SIGKILL at the rename
barrier), `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_rollback_recovery.py`,
`tests/integration/test_b636_rebuild_history_loss.py`,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_creation_channel_compaction.py`,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_compact_rebuild_counter_b2bb.py` (`_REBUILD_COUNT` stays in
`compact_rebuild`), `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py`,
`tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A normal fold and a rebuild over the same ticket directory agree on
      `source_event_uuids`; checked by the new equivalence test in
      `tests/unit/commands/test_compact_plan.py`.
- [ ] No second SNAPSHOT-envelope builder or retired rename-back exists under `src/rebar`
      outside `compact_plan.py`, and an unmarked copy fails while a reasoned
      `# compact-plan-ok:` marker excuses it; checked by the guard tests.
- [ ] A rebuild over a ticket dir holding a stray non-`.json` file leaves that file in place
      and excludes it from `source_event_uuids` (the recorded convergence); checked by the new
      edge test.
- [ ] The pinning suites listed above pass with no assertion edits, and
      `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` reports `new=0 increased=0`;
      checked by running both.
